$comment: E-056 1b block manifest (docs/STRATEGY_DESIGN_GUIDE.md §7c, built). Written by stage 1b (strategy_config_authoring, orchestrator.config_direct_authoring.enabled) next to the base config. The enforcing code is tools/block_manifest.py, shared by the backtest_specification tool stage (5a, fails loud) and tools/block_registry.py; this schema documents the same shape and tests/test_e056_1b_block_manifest.py keeps the two in agreement. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced only in code: every pointer resolves in the base config; no pointer lies inside another's subtree (block vs block, block vs scaffolding); a forecast block has a path under /strategies/regimes/, a regime block a path at or under /regime_detector.
title: artifacts/block_manifest.yaml
description: Which part of the run's base strategy config IS the idea's block, as opposed to scaffolding. No coin restriction: a validated block is usable on any coin. The idea's identity (hypothesis_id) comes from the run, not from this file.

config_paths.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointers into the base config; their values are the block (block_registry.yaml config_fragment).

scaffolding.description: Pointers to config the idea needs to run but that is not the idea (warmup, a pass-through detector, ...). May be empty.

rationale.description: Why these paths are the block and the rest is scaffolding.
